name: Obby but you're a monkey
desc:
Race through a fast-paced jungle obstacle course as a monkey! 🏃‍♂️🌴 Jump across gaps and dodge hazards to reach the finish line. 🏁 Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against others for the fastest time! ⏳💨

🔥🔥 NEW UPDATE 🔥🔥
- NEW SWING MECHANIC
- MAP EXPANSION
- 5 NEW STAGES

Features:

🦍 Monkey Parkour – Climb and leap through tricky obstacles.
🍌 Throw Bananas Gamepass– Slow down opponents with well-aimed banana throws.
⚡ Torch Gamepass – Light up your way with additional light
🎮 Multiplayer Mode – Race against friends and prove who’s the fastest.
Think you have what it takes to be the king of the jungle? 🌳🐒
